user.title: Add a Windy location
user.description: Enter at least one key from api.windy.com/keys. Each service has its own key. The Windy Plugins key isn't used here.

data_description.model: gfs is global and runs about 10 days. canHrdps is higher resolution for Canada but has a shorter range, so its daily forecast is short.
data_description.map_api_key: Used in your browser by the Windy map card, so it can't be checked until the card loads.

error.invalid_auth: Windy rejected this key. Check that it was created for this service.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't get a response from Windy. Try again.
error.no_keys: Enter at least one API key.
error.model_no_data: This model has no data for this location. Choose another model.

data_description.air_quality_model: Each model adds one Point Forecast request per update. cams is global; camsEu covers Europe only.
data_description.webcam_interval_minutes: Free-tier image links expire after 10 minutes, so keep this under 10 on a free key.
data_description.webcam_ids: Comma-separated, up to 50. When set, these replace the search by distance.

error.invalid_webcam_ids: Enter up to 50 numeric IDs separated by commas.
